notes.title: An Important Update on GotG Development
notes.content:
Hello, dear players and supporters!

I wanted to take a moment to share a personal update regarding the development of 'Greats of the Gridiron'. As the sole developer behind this project, I'm faced with unique challenges and responsibilities, and it's important for me to keep you all in the loop.

Here's what's been happening:

    [b]Decreased Interest:[/b] I've observed a dip in interest towards our game. This has been a bit disheartening and has impacted my motivation. However, I am eager to hear any ideas or feedback that might help reinvigorate the project and appeal more to our community.

    [b]Full-Time Work Commitments:[/b] Balancing game development with full-time work has been challenging. As a solo developer, I find myself juggling multiple roles, which has recently led to a slowdown in the game's progress.

Given these realities, here are some updates on how things will proceed:

    [b]Pacing of Development:[/b] Updates and progress will be slower as I balance development with other professional commitments. Rest assured, each update will be packed with as much value and progress as possible.
    [b]Continued Communication:[/b] Transparency is key. I'll keep you updated on all major milestones and any changes in the development timeline. Your understanding and support are incredibly valuable during this time.
    [b]Your Role:[/b] Your feedback, ideas, and encouragement are more important than ever. As a one-person team, community support is not just appreciated, but essential.

I understand this might be somewhat disappointing, but I believe in being open and honest about the journey of GotG. This project is my passion, and I'm dedicated to seeing it through, albeit at a more realistic pace given the current circumstances.

Thank you for your understanding, patience, and continuous support. Please feel free to reach out with your thoughts, concerns, or words of encouragement - they mean more than you know.

notes.title: Update: Tweaked how M2M Coverage Works
notes.content:
[h1][b]Man-to-Man Coverage[/b][/h1]

The M2M Coverage is working with a couple of caveats
1. we disabled the "assigned" double coverage ability

      - double coverages still happen, they are done by having "extra" defensive players who have an "open" M2M assignment and cannot find a free receiver to cover. 

2. we changed some of the priority progressions that defensive players make in order to determine who they are supposed to match up against

       - watch this our Explainer Video on how to assign M2M coverages and who is going to man up with their offensive counterpart
[previewyoutube=MSa22JwnzoQ;full][/previewyoutube]

       - here is an [url=https://greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/M2M-Explainervideo.pdf]accompanying explanation[/url] that is provided in the video

As always, hit us up with any questions you might have. We are available here on Steam as well as on [url=https://discord.gg/adQZKXqsrZ]Discord[/url]. 

- The Management Team

[b]Official Season #1 kicks off in 1 week (4/1/23)!! [/b]

notes.title: League Draft Results and Strongside/Weakside Defensive Formations
notes.content:
[h1][b]The First Official Greats of the Gridiron Draft![/b][/h1] 

It was a huge success! Thanks to all those who have joined this historic, first league and season. We are looking forward to seeing who takes home the Gridiron Bowl!!

Here was the video on the Top 10 Players [previewyoutube=sGCLUi1cV1k;full][/previewyoutube]

The main pick window:

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Banner-01.png?resize=1080%2C608&ssl=1[/img]

[h2]The draft is over and the players are signed![/h2]

Now that the league is has its Coaches and Players, playbook design is underway. With that, we have just finished the final touches of getting defenses to [b]read[/b] [i]and[/i] [b]adjust[/b] to the offense's strong and weak side formations. Here's a breakdown of how it works. 

In the [b]first[/b] [b]image[/b], there is an "orange shaded" box dividing the defensive field in half. That is the [i]defense's strongside[/i]. Whomever is lined up in this box will SHIFT to the Offense's  Strongside (see Image 2) when they take the practice field or in a game. 

The strongside in the [b]first image[/b] is where the TE is lined up. In this case, the TE is on the LEFT side of the Offensive formation. 

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Strong-Side-01.png?w=823&ssl=1[/img] IMAGE 1


See how the defensive players in the orange box set in the Coordinator's Office adjusted to where the offense's strongside is? ([b]image 2[/b]) below.

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Strong-Side-02.png?w=820&ssl=1[/img] IMAGE 2

When doing this, coaches have the freedom to tell the defensive players to overload the strongside OR weakside with the players they so want. If you wanted to overload the weakside, all the coach needs to do it line up everyone on the [b]Weak Side[/b] - the non-shaded part.... and the defense will adjust accordingly. See [b]Image 3[/b]

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Strong-Side-03.png?w=821&ssl=1[/img] IMAGE 3

And now on the Practice Field, all those players have shifted to the [b]Weakside[/b] (see image 4)

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Strong-Side-04.png?w=818&ssl=1[/img] IMAGE 4

Now defenses can blitz from the weakside or strongside with the personnel that best fits [b]any[/b] situation.

[h2][b]IMPORTANT DATABASE UPDATE[/b][/h2]
This update include a needed change to the encrypted play data. In order to do this, the UI is going to be locked on a black screen for several minutes, more or less depending on your PC specs. 

Please don't close the game during this process, or it will corrupt your database. If you need any assistance or have any questions, please post on the message boards or directly on Discord.

notes.title: Dedicated Server, 32 Teams and Official League Start
notes.content:
[h1]*** Please Read if you Purchased (or otherwise acquired) the Game Prior to January, 26 2023 ***[/h1]


[h2]Dedicated Server[/h2]

We didn't get a lot of feedback from people regarding the upcoming new release and use of the DEDICATED SERVER - so we are making one last post regarding this. There will be forthcoming tutorials and a manual on how to run a league via dedicated server.

We expect that [b]upon the release of this next version[/b] that current users (owners of the game) will have invalid databases. This unfortunately means that your data (playbooks and team files) will not be usable when the new release happens...

AGAIN, WORRY NOT!

For a limited time, if you are a current owner of GotG prior to this release, we will work with you to update your database so it is valid with the new release!

Please reach out to us via Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/adQZKXqsrZ]Discord[/url].

---------

[h2]32 Teams[/h2]

Additionally, with the new release the game will support 32 teams! This includes a season scheduler and playoff system! 

---------

[h2]Official League[/h2]

The sign-up period for the Official League ends today!  We have a good group of coaches ready to compete for the coveted Gridiron Bowl trophy and bragging rights as the first ever GotG Champion! which will earn them an automatic spot in our Hall of Fame! 

[b]It's not too late to sign up though if you haven't. If you want to sign up, head over and join Discord or shoot us a message here. [/b]

[list]
[*] If you want to sign up AFTER 1/27/2023 but [b]before[/b] the first game kicks off, you can. Just message us on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/adQZKXqsrZ]Discord[/url] and we (as well as the other league members) will decide who to accommodate you. 
[/list]

We could not do this without your continued support. We cannot thank you enough. Honestly. And we hope that with this new release, leagues will begin to form and more and more people will play this amazing game!

Cheers!

notes.title: WILL YOU be the FIRST GotG CHAMPION?
notes.content:
[h1]It's Kickoff Time!  [/h1]

[h2]Are you ready to OUTDRAFT, OUTDESIGN and OUTCOACH 31 other teams, be the first ever GotG Champion and stake your claim to Greatness?[/h2]

[h3]We are getting ready to release the most complete version to date.[/h3]

[h2]This version supports[/h2]
[list]
[*] 32 teams
[*] 17 game schedule
[*] Regular season and Playoff stats
[*] Multiplayer (32 coaches) Draft (snake and traditional)
[*] Playoff Bracket
[*] Franchise
[/list]

[h2]The OFFICIAL GotG LEAGUE - here’s what we need: [/h2]

30 coaches (teams) willing to dedicate a couple months of their time to play the game!  

[list]
[*] We understand and know that knowing league members can make things a little more “fun”. Because we are all just starting out and do not yet know each other we are proposing the following: 
- If you want to join the league and currently own the game and you know of a friend or two who would also like to join the league but hasn’t yet gotten the game, we will give them a complimentary Steam Key. 
- If you’re new to GotG and do not yet own it, this is your lucky day – we will give you a copy of the game for free (limited to 1 per person and only until we have a full league or the deadline to join the league of 01/25/2023 passes)
[/list]
[list]
[*] If we do not have 30 coaches by the end of the deadline, we will fill in the slots with NPCs
[/list]
[h3]Time Table:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]01/25/2023[/b] Deadline to join the league (first come basis) 
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]02/01/2023[/b] Deadline to pick team names (first come) 
- You can pick any name you want
- The players drafted are FICTION – with the Official GotG League, we are not going to use “real NFL” players for obvious licensing concerns
- Trust us when we say that you will develop the same level of enthusiasm for these players that you do for NFLers
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]02/01/2023[/b] Deadline for THE LEAGUE to CHOOSE DRAFT START date
The online draft will be 56 rounds and take a while (probably the course of a few days) 
- The date will be what the majority votes for because we would hope to have as many online for the first few rounds as possible
- Because we are still developing some features – there will be NO trading of picks, i.e. you cannot trade your 1st for someone’s 2nd and 3rd etc.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]02/01/2023[/b] Determine draft order (snake draft)
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]02/08/2023[/b] DEADLINE Determine KICKOFF
- Remember that you will need time to develop a playbook
- We will release some of the plays of the default teams to help you build your PBs out to get you up and running faster
- The sooner the draft takes place the sooner teams have their players and are able to being creating PBs with those players. 
- Remember that offensive plays can be affected by the speed of your players – i.e., if you create a pass play to a 75 sp player and you now have a 100sp player there – the play will need to be adjusted manually to compensate. So you can use existing plays you have, you just might have to tweak them to account for the differing speeds you might draft – same with QB arm strength. 
[/list]

This is essentially a very large Beta test of the game. It’s for FUN! Do not join if you are going to get wrapped up in winning it all. There are going to be flaws that we will fix on the fly if we can. Some might have to be pushed off until the next release. However, there will be a trophy for the winner of the league and we will find a way to share our gratitude with each coach in some way. 

Please reach out with any questions and or if you want to JOIN! 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1553880/discussions/3/]Sign up here[/url]: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1553880/discussions/3/

notes.title: UPDATE: SCOUTING
notes.content:
[b]Update: 08/19/2022 [/b]

We are toiling away in our War Room as we design and code more features of Greats of the Gridiron. Currently, we are closing in on one of the most enjoyable aspects to the season - scouting the next crop of college kids waiting for their shot at Greatness! 

For the most part, during the course of the season coaches can scout specific attribute point totals for one price or a range that is represented by a grade at a sizeable discount. Another option is to simply scout their overall grade. These 3 scouting options will make increase strategic thinking in order to try and get the most comprehensive draft board possible.

Commissioners of each league will have the ability to: 

[olist]
[*] Choose to use scouting mode for their league
[*] Choose the weekly scouting points allotted
[*] Choose whether or not the allotted points are on a "use or lose" basis
[/olist] 
Again, our main goal is to give as much customization to each commissioner as possible so that each league can be tailored for the most fun for each individual league. 

Additional advanced settings that are coming are Injury Mode and Contract Mode

Here's a sneak peek at the Main Screen for Scouting... 

[img]https://i0.wp.com/greatsofthegridiron.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Scouting-Player-Card-hover-02.png?w=1027&ssl=1[/img]

notes.title: Developer Update
notes.content:
Greetings all!

I just wanted to take a moment to give an update on what is currently underway with the progress of the current task:

[u][b]Dedicated Server[/b][/u]
This is one of the most important, but also labor intensive and time consuming modules. The payoff, is that much of the remaining functionality of the Franchise management for the leagues will be part of this module.

The 'dedicated server' is a process that will run on the League Commissioner's machine (or some remote service he may have) that will be the central connection hub for all the League members. It should run 24/7/365 and will provide the direct gateway to the league data, including player/game/season statistics, trading, scouting, messaging, injuries, and all the other data processing required to run the league, in a configurable, single process. This will represent about 70% of the remaining 'feature' level development, after which, we can cross from Alpha to Beta, then the final Public Release!

There is a small downside to this, which is that realistically, it will take several months. There MAY (or may not) be a change in the database engine to accommodate multiple database connections during this time. I am going to try to avoid this, as using SQLite now is the most efficient way for a data repository, but it comes with some limitations. There will also necessarily be much development in the way of networking, and some improvements/changes may be happening there as well.

Thus, until this module is done, there will be little in the way of major updates, however, I will still be working bugs, improving performance and all that stuff. I don't know exactly how long it will take, but I will update regularly with milestones, and other general information.

There will be a full level of tutorial available on running your league via the dedicated server to help you get started when it's ready.

As always, please feel free to provide any feedback or suggestion on the message boards or on Discord, where I am generally online all the time, if you'd like to directly as for assistance, info, or generally just to chat!

Thanks for your continued support and see you in the next update!

notes.title: League Update
notes.content:
[b]LEAGUE UPDATE: 06/24/2022[/b]

Sorry for the delay in getting this out. Wanted to be sure we really knew as much as we could before making a decision on what our league options are: 

Due to some unforeseen circumstances, we are still working on getting the online aspects of the multiplayer functionality (as in being able to hop on the game via Steam and then see all types of information about the online league such as the teams, their records, schedules, games, stats, trades, FAs etc.) 

[b]What does this mean?[/b]

[i]As of now, we’re going to have to push back doing the league as an online/multiplayer one for now. [/i]

We understand the damper this puts on everything, but just know we are working diligently to get the multiplayer functional ASAP.

So, what are our options now? 

1.	[b]LEAGUE: [/b]We can still do a league but we cannot use the multiplayer functionality of the game

a.	This would mean that certain things like stats would still be tracked, but they would need to be exported and compiled via excel 

b.	Trades and stuff would also all need to be done offline and then reported to the league and updated

c.	Basically, we would run a league but everything will require us to do all the things the multiplayer is supposed to make efficient and connective via online

d.	We would have to discuss whether or not to draft. An offline draft with so many players and people (since it is an inaugural draft) would take a lifetime to complete. Perhaps we cut the draft in half – a truncated draft of 22 rounds just to fill in basic starters and then we can randomly assign backups

f.	Or we can randomly create the full team rosters and then you draft a full team based on your draft position

2.	[b]TOURNAMENT:[/b] We can set up a round robin tournament and have everyone create one master playbook that will be used throughout

a.	We can set some point totals and player allocation totals and allow each coach to set up their team as they want

b.	Or we can do a truncated draft

c.	Or we can draft premade teams

No matter which we choose - someone will get that trophy!! 

3. [b]POSTPONE:[/b] Our final option is to wait until the multiplayer is fully functional (or at least the vast majority of it) 

Please leave a comment on the message boards as to what you want to do along with the corresponding option # (1, 2 or 3). 

Thanks again for your support and patience as we continue to develop the game in early access.

notes.title: Update Re-post: 0.1.321
notes.content:
The previous update is being re-posted here due to some issues with the prior post visibility. This update is rather major, and although there are no issue reports since 9, June, nevertheless please read the below:

Update 0.1.321:
Additions/Improvements
* Add fans to stadium for better immersion at game time. Use the Options Menu to enable or disable the fans as well as the count that show up to game day.
* Custom emblems can now be imported and used for your teams. Please watch the tutorial video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JaOv4xod27E on how to set up and import your custom logo into the game. NOTE: league commissioners will have to distribute any league team's custom emblem to the league coaches. Logos MUST be 512x512 in size and be in .png format, or it won't work!

IMPORTANT:
If you are updating from prior to 0.1.321, please follow the below instructions to configure your data source locations for your current leagues. If you are not concerned with any previous data, you can simply start the game and use the automatically created league.

[olist]
[*] After updating start the game, accept the Privacy Statement and wait for the game to automatically create a default league as it will on first run.
[*] PLEASE READ THIS STEP CAREFULLY: 

Once completed, go to the Options menu. Click the folder icon next to the Data Directory option. Use this to select your preferred directory to save your data files. NOTE: this location should be a substantially large location as the data will get to be quite sizable over time. 

ADDITIONALLY: you are under no obligation to change this from the default setting, however you may want to if you have a larger space to save to.

FURTHER: I am not deleting any of your files during this process, so if you are careful and something goes wrong, you will not have lost your data unless you deleted or overwrote it yourself. So - please be careful and feel free to ask for help on Discord or the Message Boards before moving any files.

[*] Close the game - this is important as once you copy your leagues, the game will need to update your current databases on startup.
[*] Changing this data location will copy the default (any any other) league to this new location under a new "Leagues" directory.
[*] Navigate to your Steam installation and navigate to the "<SteamInstall>/steamapps/common/Greats Of The Gridiron/GreatsOfTheGridiron/Saved/data" directory. In here, you will see your current league directories.
[*] Copy all these league folders to your selected <dataSource>/Leagues directory. If you already have a Default league
[*] Start the game, go to a module (Play, Coordinator's Office, or League Management) and File->Open League. You should see all your previous leagues to be available to play.
[/olist]

As usual, please ask on Discord or on the message boards if you need any assistance.

Fixes:
* Entry Menu buttons incorrectly enabled while validating the installation
* Tweaks to grass materials
* Crash when using File Dialogs
* Improve general performance significantly.
* Clean up some logging warnings

notes.title: Inaugural League and Game Update
notes.content:
First - we are still looking for a few more coaches to join our inaugural league. We currently have 11 coaches ready to go but we need 5 more brave people to pit their skills against the rest of the league. 

While we could go with just 11, we feel it best to have a league full of humans so that no one is coaching against NPCs and this way trading will be more fun and active as will the initial draft. So, if you know anyone who wants to be part of history - have them reach out to us. 

Game development: 

1. We always knew in the back of our minds that a custom logo importer was needed - well look no further as it will be in the next release. Instructions on how this will work are coming soon

2. In the next build there will be a performance boost! Yay, say all those who are on the lower end of the specs. 

3. We have added some "eye-candy" and in the next build you can have fans in your stadium! This will be a feature that can be turned on or off to help with any kind of performance on the PC. But it looks great and adds that extra detail. it's only visible when in the 3D mode of the camera during the games.

One of the things we are looking to add is a way to test the PCA without having to play games as well as a randomizer when you're practicing an offensive or defensive play out. Stay tuned as we work on those.

Again we want to thank everyone for their feedback and support - it's because you of you that we're able to make this game better and better.

notes.title: Update 02.17.22
notes.content:
Greetings one and all!

This is a quick update to address a couple items in which those of you on the wish may be asking: what happened to the store page?

Basically, due to... an"external issue", the Steam Store page for GotG was temporarily shut down for just about 1 month. We should NOT have an issue like this occur again. The issue has been "resolved" in terms of the Steam page is back up. I will be working diligently to make sure this absolutely does NOT happen again.

Enough on that.

Development Progress:
The development of the game was paused for just about 1 month, while working through the issues with Steam. This does cause the release date to be pushed back by at least this amount of time, possible more. Since I've already pushed the date back once from Sept '21 to May '22, pushing back the date will no longer be an option. Instead, there will be an Early Access release once the following items have been completed:
[list]
[*] Finishing up drafting (AI and Multiplayer)
[*] Finishing up statistics tracking and presentation
[*] Finishing up Season play
[*] Making sure all this works correctly over the network
[/list]

Once these items are completed and in a working state, there will be an Early Access release. The time frame for the game to be in Early Access will be approximately 6 months. This time will mainly be used for polish and issue fixes and stress tests. There likely won't be any additional features added during this time unless there is some very compelling feature to add, with the exception of administration tools as they are needed (database, servers, etc). The game will be for the most part, complete. 

During the Early Access phase of the release, there can be expected to be bugs and other quirks that will be cleaned up and resolved. The date of the Early Access release is as yet unknown, but if the remaining major tasks can be completed before May '22, the EA release will be at that earlier time.

Finally, the Demo has been taken down. It no longer accurately represents the game in its more completed incarnation, with many changes to the UI and functionality. It is doubtful there will be another demo release.

Thanks for the support and until next time!

notes.title: Developer Quick Update
notes.content:
Greetings loyal football fans!

A quick update to inform on the progress of data transfers for casual PvP play:

After much trial and tribulation working in the confines of UE4 and Steam networking, transferring datasets directly for play has been completed! This is HUGE good news, as due to the amazing and vast LACK of any useful documentation on how this is achieved, I have reverse engineered enough to do what needs to be done.

In the following several weeks, I anticipate that the same will be completed for the coupe de grace of the League/Franchise play: Online, real-time, team/player drafting within the league.

I anticipate developing this will be even more trying that the simple data transfer, but real-time drafting will be a big part of the GotG experience and thus, needs to be given the same level of persistence and wall banging as ever before.

I am up to the challenge and look forward to delivering the next update, which hopefully will include a completion notice of this module.

And the best part is, after the PvP draft work is completed, I will be able to dedicate myself full-time to bug-hunting and polishing and improvements, which we have a lot of ideas for, well before release.

Thanks for your continued patience and support and see you in the next update!

notes.title: We Continue to Make Progress
notes.content:
Hello Coaches! 

Sorry for the delay between updates - it took us a few hoops to jump through to get our Kickstarter page set up - but it is and should go live 10/1 and we are definitely looking forward to your support! You can definitely get some great perks by supporting the campaign. 

- Name and number a default team's stud player
- Name a default team's stadium
- Get your name in the credits with a "[b][i]12th Man[/i][/b]" badge
- Get a cool HoF Bust with your face caricaturized - this one is cool!
- Name a whole default team, pick their city/state, and head coach... and... meet us, the GotG Team! Oh, and you'll also get a custom GotG jersey :)

And of course - get the game!

More news on the KS later. 

Actual Greats of the Gridiron game development news! 

We have the team divisions/conferences all worked out and we are still working on the online and single player drafts/franchise mode. Good news on that front - we are going to launch with 31 default teams rather than 15 so you can play a full compliment of teams!  We are also working hard at getting it so the PC will draft against you. You have to keep in mind that this is no simple task because of the fact each play is highly predicated on working based on the attribute #s of the player in that position. Example, a 100sp WR retires and is replaced by an 80sp WR - a play that was designed for a 100sp WR will no longer work with his 80sp replacement (for the most part) - but we are working on ways to make it work, and it's exciting!! 

So again, thank you all for you patience and understanding as we continue the journey to bring you our vision for the next thing in football simulation (that doesn't require thumb dexterity)! 

-The GotG Team

notes.title: Launch Postponement/Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 

First, thank you all for your support over the last year and half. We are extremely grateful for all the feedback you've provided us, as well as the encouragement that what we've been toiling over for so long now is worth it - even more, that pushing the release date back to put out a FULL and COMPLETE game that has all the bells and whistles we initially wanted, in addition to a lot of the ideas generated by the community - is the best way to go. 

With that said, [b]we are pushing the release date for Greats of the Gridiron to early spring 2022.[/b]

[b]Perhaps the biggest reason for the pushback is that we want to expand to 31 default teams, improve the CPU's AI especially in terms of them being able to draft against you, as well as their play calling ability so that it's more adaptive. [/b]

Here are the other feature coming: 

[b]SINGLE PLAYER[/b]

* Season Mode (just play a season with a playoff) 
* Franchise Mode (play multiple season with drafts and retirements and salary cap)
* 31 default teams rather than 15
* Simulate the games between computer teams
* Full assortment of stats and the ability to download
* Computer simulated draft 

[b]MULTIPLAYER (ONLINE)[/b]

* Not a lot of new features are going on here but we are working on improving the draft user interface as well as graphics (including character portraits)

[b]Play Characteristics[/b]

* Player injury % (some players are more prone to injury and we want to factor that in)
* Diamond in the Rough feature (some draftees are like TB12 and can be a diamond!  Whereas some like Jamarcus Russell are a fool's gold - we want to explore this option in both multi and single player modes
* Character portraits - we want to get better and more variety

The other main reason is that a lot of community members had expressed interest in "getting in on the action" and helping us create default teams and playbooks for the game's initial release - and we thought this was a great idea because it would add so much more variety/parody to the game for single player mode. 

So, we've decided to launch a Kickstarter campaign that gives everyone the opportunity to enjoy some of the new perks we're making available. We didn't want to exclude anyone without first giving them the opportunity.  

Here's quick look at some of the opportunities backers will get: 

[list]
[*] Get the game at a discounted price
[/list]
[list]
[*] Get the game before it's release on Steam
[/list]
[list]
[*] Have access to the Coordinator's Office where you can create a team and playbook well in advance of the game's release so that you're ahead of the pack
[/list]
[list]
[*] Name one of the Default Teams, pick their logo, have your name as the head coach
[/list]
[list]
[*] Have your name as one of the QBs, HBs or WRs (any position)
[/list]

Again, to recap - we are pushing the release date back to early spring 2022 so that we can work on bringing the game to MAC users, improve and expand on single player mode, give community members the opportunity to leave their mark on the default teams which will ship to every new user. We are also working on a redesign of the end zone, more sound effects and a Hall of Fame bust area where your players can retire and be seen by the world (complete with clickable interface that shows their stats and bio (which you get to write up). 

We hope you continue to support us despite what might be an initial disappointment at the delay. We promise you that this is only to make the game as greats possible from day one because that's what every gamer deserves. 

We are looking at launching the Kickstarter campaign around October 1st. We will link here for that. 

Until then - please always feel free to reach out to us: greatsofthegridirion@gmail.com

- The Management Team

notes.title: Team/Playbook Transfer Now Happening!
notes.content:
We have successfully transferred a playbook and team from a computer in Wyoming to a computer in Maryland!! So now you can create a team and playbook, send it to a friend (or challenger) and find out who has the better players, plays and coaching ability...

Additionally,  another important feature has been completed and that is the Play Commentary. Now you can review the plays called for analysis. There's also a nice scoring summary as part of the commentary.

notes.title: Back from Vacation!
notes.content:
Well, it was a great couple weeks off - something we have not had in the last 1.5 years of development. It was much needed, but we are very excited to be back to work on Greats of the Gridiron. 

During our break we met a great network of guys over in Front Office Football who gave some wonderful feedback on the Demo. We are working on ways to incorporate their feedback into GotG. 

We also had a very successful Steam Next Fest. Thanks to the hundreds of supporters who downloaded the demo, wishlisted the game and again, gave us great feedback. We really are making this game for you - the fans of football simulation games that are not joystick controlled players. 

Well, now that we are back please expect the usual weekly updates as well as some exciting news that we cannot leak yet, but will as soon as we're able! 

Everyone in the U.S. have a great (and safe) Independence Day. And for the rest of you - just have a kickass weekend!

- The Management Team
